Package org.cyborgcats.io.motor

Interface MotorIO

All Known Implementing Classes:
MotorIOSim, MotorIOTalonFX
public interface MotorIO
Hardware abstraction for a single motor. Implementations drive one motor and report its telemetry; follower behaviour is handled by MotorComponent rather than here.
